author: cloud-brain-12h
title: Feature Audit: home_next (Fatigue/Rest) + team_elo_5y Variants — Top-2 Most Predictive Features per Multiple SOTA Studies

sources.title: Machine Learning for Basketball Game Outcomes: NBA and WNBA (CNN Brier=0.221)
Uncertainty-Aware ML for NBA Forecasting (LR Brier=0.199, XGB=0.202)
Comparative Evaluation of ML Models for NBA Prediction

basis.finding: 'home_next', 'team_elo_5_y', and 'team_elo' consistently emerge as top-3 most influential features across ALL models and studies. home_next captures next-game schedule context (fatigue, back-to-back indicator). team_elo_5_y captures 5-year organizational trajectory drift not visible in single-season ELO.
basis.our_best: S18 0.22248 (live), fleet best 0.22073 (S22, hist). SOTA LR achieves 0.199 with these features.
basis.gap: 0.022 Brier gap from SOTA LR 0.199. Feature completeness is a primary differentiator per literature.

required_features.audit_question: Do these exist in the 54 categories? Search engine.py for 'rest', 'back_to_back', 'home_next'. If missing: add Schedule_Rest category.
Do we have multi-horizon ELO? Search for 'elo_5' or '5y'. The 5-year ELO variant captures organizational trajectory (rebuilds, dynasty runs) not visible in single-season.
Confirm rolling windows exist for home AND away × 5/10/15 game horizons. MDPI 2026 uncertainty-aware paper uses rolling-form explicitly.
required_features.expected_brier_delta: Likely already present — verify all 3 horizons covered for both home/away
